_note: Episode 11 (S2E3), Season 2 version 4 rules: the first wish (present day, no dog), the first hologram with Mga Kakampi, the first creature (the Yúmud, Agusan Manobo kuwentong-bayan: a water wraith of deep pools, drawn as a calm figure of water and moss, never a monster that is killed). Butuan river port, 1011. Real people (traders, crews, the envoy at the Song court) are generic figures, far or from behind; Rajah Kiling appears only as light. The Song court is shown only through the lens. The Golden Tara is a generic seated gold figurine, not a copy. No weapons. Copied from Episode 10: full intro, notebook_glow, ships_north; chars indio_point_modern, usman_growl; plate school_gate. Present-day scenes have no dog (Usman exists only in the jump light and in the past): the sidecar is empty with his red kerchief tied to it. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k109 are montage extras.
